columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_GOAL_ID
columns.description: The system generated surrogate key for this entry.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence in which goals will be displayed in a goal plan

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_BUSINESS_GROUPS

columns.name: GOAL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRG_GOALS, which represents the goal for which action is created.

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRG_GOAL_PLANS_B, which holds ID of goal plan.

columns.name: WEIGHTING
columns.description: weight or importance of a goal relative to other goals expressed in percentage.

columns.name: PRIORITY_CODE
columns.description: Priority of goal. Possible values are High, Medium and Low.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_SET_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRG_GOAL_PLAN_SETS_B

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Denormalized column ASSIGNMENT_ID.  Added for use by OTBI VOs only - value is never populated on this table.

columns.name: REVIEW_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Review period id needed for filtering goals added to primary goal plan

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
